$panel_width_constraint: UI panel 236px, 2 lines — target <=24 chars ideal, <=32 hard max
$adm0_override_notes: Override rules apply BEFORE suffix strip. This is an exact-match key -> value replacement.
For 'Central African Republic' / 'Dominican Republic' etc: name kept as-is because the 'Republic' is genuinely part of the common English name (no shorter form exists).
'Côte d'Ivoire' -> 'Ivory Coast' chosen for panel readability + English audience. If Cairn later ships French locale, this can be reversed via locale override.
'DR Congo' preferred over 'Congo (DR)' to keep 8 chars — fits panel comfortably and distinguishes from Congo (COG).
'St.' abbreviation used only for VCT/KNA because full 'Saint Vincent and the Grenadines' is 30 chars and wraps ugly. USA/BLM etc keep 'Saint' spelled out.
'United Kingdom' NOT abbreviated to 'UK' — users expect proper form on country pins.
'United Arab Emirates' NOT abbreviated to 'UAE' — same reason; 20 chars still fits.
$adm0_country_suffix_strip_notes: Intentionally EMPTY. ADM0 uses explicit override map only — no algorithmic stripping.
Rationale: only ~19 of 230 geoBoundaries ADM0 names have long-form suffixes. Enumerating exact overrides is safer than pattern strip.
Pattern strip would break legitimate cases like 'Central African Republic', 'Dominican Republic', 'Papua New Guinea' etc.
If new countries appear in future data drops, add to adm0_country_override map explicitly.
$adm1_suffix_strip_notes: Applied in ORDER (top wins). Longest phrases first to avoid partial matches — e.g. 'Special Administrative Region' must strip before ' Region'.
Strip is LEFT-TO-RIGHT suffix match only. Never strip mid-string.
'Republic' NOT in strip list — 'Sakha Republic', 'Komi Republic', 'Republic of Karelia' etc. are the canonical short names (leading 'Republic of' also NOT stripped — see Russia notes).
'Territory' / 'State' / 'Island(s)' / 'Cape' NOT in strip list — too many exceptions. If a Story needs them stripped later, add per-country override.
' län' (Swedish for 'county') stripped for Sweden — 21 occurrences.
Chile 'Región de X' handled via separate encoding-fix override (see adm1_encoding_fix_override).
New Zealand 'X Region' -> 'X' — 13 regions consistently benefit.
Thailand 'X Province' -> 'X' — 75 provinces consistently benefit; 'Bangkok' and 'Kalasin' already clean.
$adm1_suffix_strip_exceptions_notes: Exception list is checked BEFORE strip. If raw_name matches exactly (case-sensitive), no strip.
'Northern Territory' (AU) — stripping ' Territory' yields 'Northern', which is not a place.
'Prince Edward Island' (CA) / 'Rhode Island' (US) — 'Island' is core to the name.

'Bay of Plenty Region' (NZ) — stripping ' Region' yields 'Bay of Plenty' which is FINE, but keep original because 'Bay of Plenty' can also refer to the water body. This is a soft exception — could be moved to strip list if UX prefers.
'Chatham Islands Territory' (NZ) — stripping ' Territory' would collide with cases above; keep.
'Northern Cape/Eastern Cape/Western Cape' (ZA) — stripping ' Cape' yields directional word only.
'Northern Ireland' (GBR) — country component, do not touch.

adm1_encoding_fix_override.$description: geoBoundaries Chile ADM1 file has UTF-8 double-encoding (mojibake). Fix explicit.

adm1_name_diff_resolutions.reason: NE has correct Portuguese diacritic; gb lost it in ASCII conversion. Diacritics preferred for BRA — matches standard atlases.
Same rationale — 'Pará' is the correct form, 'Para' collides with English preposition.
Canonical global spelling — 'Sao Paulo' looks wrong to any Brazilian audience.
Strip suffix per adm1_suffix_strip. NE already correct.
Strip suffix; 'Shaanxi' (陕西) vs 'Shanxi' (山西) — spelling matters.
NE form matches Indonesian government English spelling (no hyphen). Panel-friendly.
IAST macrons unfamiliar to English speakers. NE plain-ASCII form is the standard global English spelling for all Indian states.
Plain ASCII per IND policy above.

adm1_name_diff_resolutions.gb_name: Dādra and Nagar Haveli and Damān and Diu
adm1_name_diff_resolutions.ne_name: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
adm1_name_diff_resolutions.reason: Full name is 41 chars — overflow panel. Truncated form + '&' matches how most atlases render. 'and Daman and Diu' dropped in short form.

$adm1_name_diff_policy: Rule 1 — Portuguese/Spanish/French diacritics: KEEP (São Paulo, Paraná, Ñuble, Réunion). These are canonical spellings recognizable globally.

Rule 2 — Indian IAST macrons (ā ī ū ṇ ṛ etc.): STRIP to plain ASCII. NE form is the accepted global English rendering; macrons look foreign to English readers and are not used by Indian government English publications.
Rule 3 — Chinese pinyin: no diacritics ever added (Chinese official English uses toneless pinyin). Only strip administrative suffixes.
Rule 4 — 'CHN Guangzhou Province' looks like a data bug (should be Guangdong). Flag for follow-up but do not auto-correct — belongs in city-overrides pipeline, not name-rules.

adm1_country_specific_overrides.$description: Named overrides that DON'T fit generic strip rules. Applied after suffix strip.

$adm1_country_specific_overrides_notes: CHN autonomous regions: use short common English name — 'Tibet' not 'Xizang', 'Inner Mongolia' not 'Nei Mongol'. Aligns with international news usage.
'Ningxia Ningxia Hui...' — this appears to be a duplicated-word bug in geoBoundaries. Override to plain 'Ningxia'.

'Taiwan Province' — political sensitivity. geoBoundaries labels it as CHN ADM1; we render as 'Taiwan'. This does not imply political stance — matches how UN/ISO name records treat it and keeps panel neutral.
RUS: 'Republic of X' vs 'X Republic' — geoBoundaries inconsistent. Strip both patterns to bare name.
'Jewish AO' — 12 chars; full 'Jewish Autonomous Oblast' is 24 chars but reads awkward as a single label. AO abbreviation acceptable.
USA District of Columbia -> Washington DC (12 chars; unambiguous).
AUS ACT — 'Australian Capital Territory' is 27 chars; 'ACT' widely recognized in AU context. Acceptable exception to the 'no abbreviations' rule.
$processing_pipeline: Step 1: Detect encoding damage (Ã³, Ã©, etc.) -> apply adm1_encoding_fix_override table by exact match. Skip Steps 2-4 if matched.
Step 2: Apply adm1_country_specific_overrides[iso] by exact match. Skip Steps 3-4 if matched.
Step 3: Check adm1_suffix_strip_exceptions list — if raw name matches exactly, return as-is.
Step 4: Apply adm1_suffix_strip in order (longest first). Return the transformed name.
Step 5 (ADM0 only): Apply adm0_country_override by exact match. If no match, return raw name unchanged.
Step 6: Post-process diacritic policy — for ISO in ['IND'], convert IAST macrons to plain ASCII if raw still contains them. For BRA/ESP/FRA/PRT/DEU etc., keep diacritics.
Step 7: If final length > 32 chars, log to seed-warnings for manual review — do NOT auto-truncate.

Q2: 'Aysén del Gral.Ibáñez del Campo' — Chile long form; encoding fix truncates to 'Aysén'. Confirm short form acceptable.
Q3: 'CHN Guangzhou Province' likely data corruption (should be Guangdong). Not a naming rule — flag for city-overrides fix.
